stories.title: Il ritorno di Fiorello su Rai1: ed il varietà illumina radio e tv

en.title: Fiorello's return to Rai1: variety show lights up radio and TV
en.summary: Fiorello is expected to return with a variety show on Rai1 and Radio2 in late October. The announcement was made through a social media video rather than traditional press channels.

en.title: Weather forecast for Sunday, September 27
en.summary: Weather conditions are being forecasted for Italy on Sunday, September 27.

stories.title: Due panda giganti dalla Cina in volo verso uno zoo negli Usa

en.title: Two giant pandas from China heading to US zoo
en.summary: China is sending two giant pandas, named Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, to a zoo in the United States as part of a diplomatic arrangement. A farewell ceremony was held for the animals.

stories.title: Caso Garlasco, Garofano sentito sui pedali della bicicletta di Stasi: 24 ore alla decisione

en.title: Garlasco case: Garofano questioned on Stasi's bicycle pedals; 24 hours to decision
en.summary: The former commander of the Ris Parma unit was questioned regarding initial investigations into bicycle pedals. A judge will decide within 24 hours on whether to proceed to trial against Andrea Sempio.

stories.title: Zelensky: "Putin cerca pretesti per continuare la guerra"

en.title: Zelensky: "Putin seeks pretexts to continue the war"
en.summary: Russian forces conducted new attacks on Kyiv and Zaporizhzhia with casualties reported. Vatican official Parolin stated at the UN General Assembly that ending hostilities is urgently needed after four years of war.

stories.title: “Al droga party in casa della prof il pusher fatto a pezzi per 50 euro”

en.title: "Drug party at teacher's house: drug dealer beaten to death over 50 euros"
en.summary: A youth confessed to killing a man at a gathering at a teacher's home in Turin, with disturbing messages discovered on Instagram related to the incident.

stories.title: Vannacci ritocca la foto di Siracusano. Il centrodestra: volgare e inaccettabile

en.title: Vannacci alters photo of Siracusano. Center-right: vulgar and unacceptable
en.summary: A Forza Italia deputy received cross-party solidarity after a photo alteration incident. The controversy occurs amid broader center-right tensions regarding voting in Calabria.

stories.title: Zelensky, 'Mosca cerca ogni pretesto per evitare i negoziati e continuare la guerra'

en.title: Zelensky: 'Moscow seeks every pretext to avoid negotiations and continue the war'
en.summary: Zelensky stated that Putin repeatedly makes excuses to avoid meetings and sustain military operations.

stories.title: Ucciso e fatto a pezzi, De Oliveira: "Non so come ho fatto, da giorni sotto effetto di droga"

en.title: Killed and dismembered, De Oliveira: "I don't know how I did it, under the effect of drugs for days"
en.summary: A 26-year-old man was questioned regarding the murder of Fabio Colapietro, whose dismembered body was discovered in a professor's Turin residence. The suspect claimed to have no recollection of his actions while under prolonged drug influence.

stories.title: 15enne si arrampica sul traliccio elettrico e muore folgorato: ipotesi sfida social

en.title: 15-year-old climbs electrical pylon and dies electrocuted: social media challenge hypothesis
en.summary: A 15-year-old boy died after climbing an electrical pylon to approximately 20 meters despite warning signs. A selfie found on his smartphone taken at the top suggests he may have been attempting to create extreme content for social media.

stories.title: Polemiche per la foto 'modificata' di Siracusano rilanciata da Vannacci

en.title: Controversy over 'modified' photo of Siracusano shared by Vannacci
en.summary: Tajani called the action dishonorable. A general faces accusations against him without concrete basis, according to the outlet's reporting.

stories.title: Lodi, 15enne morto folgorato su un traliccio nel lodigiano, ipotesi incidente per sfida social

en.title: Lodi, 15-year-old killed by electrocution on pylon in Lodi area, suspected accident from social media challenge
en.summary: A 15-year-old boy named Jacopo Rossi Trabattoni was found dead on an electrical pylon Friday evening by power company technicians. The death is suspected to have resulted from a social media challenge accident.

stories.title: Caputi: «Trasformare l’attrattività dell’Italia in ricchezza diffusa»

en.title: Caputi: "Transform Italy's attractiveness into widespread wealth"
en.summary: An end-of-term agreement with the government includes a simplification decree to convert Italy's appeal into broader economic benefits.
